forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {味|あじ}わっていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To perceive the flavor of food or drink, often appreciatively.
To undergo or feel an experience, emotion, or sensation deeply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧わって⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Eat the food slowly and savor it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧わって⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please savor the aroma of this wine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧わった。
examples.english: I experienced the joy of success.

examples.english: I savored the flavor of the tea carefully.

examples.english: I fully savored autumn in Kyoto.

examples.english: I experienced the pain of failure.

examples.english: For the first time, I experienced both the anxiety and freedom of living alone abroad.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{味|あじ}わう (to taste/experience X).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing appreciation. ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧わって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is savoring.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{味|あじ}わう (to savor food)
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{味|あじ}わう (to experience life)
- ⟦{苦|くる}しみ→苦しみ：14120_kurushimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{味|あじ}わう (to experience suffering)
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{味|あじ}わう (to experience joy)
- ⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦{深|ぶか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (full of flavor/depth)

NUANCE: {味|あじ}わう implies careful, appreciative attention, not just casual tasting or experiencing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ - to eat (neutral)
- ⟦{試食|ししょく}→試食：03060_shishoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to sample food
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to experience (more neutral)
